Start a local WebDriver service

Source: R/auto_cs.R
auto_cs.Rd

Starts, or reuses, the managed WebDriver service for one browser. Chrome is served at 127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub and Edge at 127.0.0.1:4445.

Usage

auto_cs(
  dest_dir,
  autostart = TRUE,
  browser = c("chrome", "edge"),
  backend = c("selenium", "chromedriver"),
  restart = c("if_idle", "never")
)

Arguments

dest_dir

Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.

autostart

Whether to install or update the hidden Windows login startup entry. Use FALSE to start the service without writing it.

browser

Browser to manage, either chrome or edge.

backend

Chrome only. "selenium" runs Selenium Server 3.141.59 on Java, which also accepts the legacy JSON Wire protocol used by RSelenium. "chromedriver" runs ChromeDriver directly at the same address (W3C protocol only) and needs neither Java nor get_ss().

restart

What to do when the running service uses a different driver, for example after a browser update. "if_idle" restarts it when it has no open sessions; "never" raises an error instead.

Value

Invisibly NULL once the service is ready.

Examples

if (FALSE) auto_cs("C:/pptsdd-webdriver") # \dontrun{}
